title: petrorchis bicornis
intro: Petrorchis bicornis, commonly known as the two-horned orchid or two-horned petrorhiza, is a type of flowering plant native to Australia, known for its unique appearance and medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of various gastrointestinal issues and respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Petrorhiza include its role as a demulcent, soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, and its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve nausea. Bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoids, such as petrorhizin and petrone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
